title: ChaptersFile
description: The chapters.json file of one studio lesson. It is the single source of truth for the HUD pills and the docs page.

slug.description: Must equal the project file name, e.g. "db-indexing" for src/projects/db-indexing.ts.

theme.description: Optional theme id. Unknown ids are skipped with a console warning.

mode.description: Optional theme mode. The theme's defaultMode is used when omitted.

summaryPoints.description: What the viewer learns. Used by the lesson page and the YouTube description.

name.description: Short upper-case label shown in the HUD pill, e.g. "FULL TABLE SCAN".

color.description: Palette key resolved to hex inside the scene.

summary.description: One sentence for the docs page. Not shown in the video.

at.description: Timestamp in the final render, e.g. "4:12" or "1:04:12". Filled in after the render.
